title: Find the IDs and artists of cards that are legal in the 'pauper' format, av
question: Find the IDs and artists of cards that are legal in the 'pauper' format, available in paper, illustrated by either 'Erica Yang' or 'Jim Pavelec', and belong to sets released after January 1, 2020. Among these, return only those with unknown power (either NULL or '*').

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_001", T1."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_099"
WHERE T2."XCL_084" = 'pauper'
  AND T1."XCL_004" = 'paper'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN ('Erica Yang', 'Jim Pavelec')
  AND T3."XCL_112" > '2020-01-01'
  AND (T1."XCL_055" IS NULL OR T1."XCL_055" = '*')
